Batch processing

Apply one action to many PDFs — no artificial caps.

Compress, rotate, protect, number or watermark an unlimited number of PDFs in one run, then download every result as a ZIP. Processing happens in your browser, so the only limit is device memory.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Batch processing works

  1. Add as many PDFs as you need.
  2. Choose one operation and its settings.
  3. Process the batch locally and download the ZIP.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Compress PDF — Cut file size without turning text to mush.
  • Protect PDF — Real AES-256 encryption, never uploaded.
